description: Agentes de Geração de Energia Elétrica is a dataset listed in Brazilian electricity regulator open data portal (ANEEL), an open data portal, published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica. Lista de Agentes de Geração de Energia Elétrica relacionando as Usinas e seus respectivos CEGs, CNPJ e Percentual de Participação por agente na propriedade do empreendimento e o regime de exploração do mesmo em relação a este empreendimento. Coverage: Brasil. The portal files it under the publisher Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica. Its tags are CEG, RALIE, SIGA, agentes, cnpj. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-repos-br-aneel.
